name: hourly_node_telemetry
description: Regular hourly grid: one row per node per hour, NO missing hours. Produced by Stage02_DL/01_data_engineer.py as Stage02_DL/data/hourly_node_telemetry.csv. Consumed by the DL model, EDA, Evaluation, and (as the baseline) by Stage 5.

columns.name: hour_ts
columns.note: Top of the hour, ISO-8601, UTC

columns.name: throughput_teu_per_hr
columns.note: For CHOKEPOINT nodes this is TEU-equivalent derived from vessel transits; document the conversion in the HANDOFF file.

columns.name: is_imputed
columns.note: True when the hour had no raw records and values were filled.
